def factor_range_vol_squeeze_boost(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    short_ma_range = range_.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    long_ma_range = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_ratio = short_ma_range / long_ma_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    is_high_vol, _, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    base_factor = -range_ratio
    boost = 1.0 + 0.2 * is_high_vol
    factor = base_factor * boost
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_squeeze_boost"] = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_squeeze_boost"]
